mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM group_link_preview preview LEFT JOIN group_link link ON preview.tenant_id = link.tenant_id AND preview.group_link_id = link.id WHERE preview.group_jid IS NOT NULL AND ( link.id IS NULL OR TRIM(preview.group_jid) = '' OR LOWER(TRIM(preview.group_jid)) NOT LIKE '%@g.us' )

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT preview.tenant_id, LOWER(TRIM(preview.group_jid)) AS group_jid FROM group_link_preview preview INNER JOIN group_link link ON preview.tenant_id = link.tenant_id AND preview.group_link_id = link.id WHERE preview.group_jid IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(preview.group_jid) <> '' GROUP BY preview.tenant_id, LOWER(TRIM(preview.group_jid)) HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ) duplicate_group
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wa_group ( tenant_id, group_jid, folder_id, display_name, avatar_url, remark, origin, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at ) SELECT preview.tenant_id, LOWER(TRIM(preview.group_jid)) AS group_jid, link.folder_id, NULLIF(TRIM(link.group_name), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(preview.avatar_url), ''), link.remark, link.origin, LEAST(link.created_at, preview.created_at), GREATEST(link.updated_at, preview.updated_at), link.deleted_at FROM group_link_preview preview INNER JOIN group_link link ON preview.tenant_id = link.tenant_id AND preview.group_link_id = link.id LEFT JOIN wa_group target ON target.tenant_id = preview.tenant_id AND target.group_jid = LOWER(TRIM(preview.group_jid)) WHERE preview.group_jid IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(preview.group_jid) <> '' AND LOWER(TRIM(preview.group_jid)) LIKE '%@g.us' AND ( target.id IS NULL OR ( GREATEST(link.updated_at, preview.updated_at) >= target.updated_at AND ( NOT (target.folder_id <=> link.folder_id) OR ( NULLIF(TRIM(link.group_name), '') IS NOT NULL AND NOT (target.display_name <=> NULLIF(TRIM(link.group_name), '')) ) OR ( NULLIF(TRIM(preview.avatar_url), '') IS NOT NULL AND NOT (target.avatar_url <=> NULLIF(TRIM(preview.avatar_url), '')) ) OR NOT (target.remark <=> link.remark) OR NOT (target.deleted_at <=> link.deleted_at) ) ) OR target.created_at > LEAST(link.created_at, preview.created_at) ) ORDER BY preview.tenant_id ASC, group_jid ASC LIMIT #{limit} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE folder_id = CASE WHEN VALUES(updated_at) >= wa_group.updated_at OR VALUES(created_at) < wa_group.created_at THEN VALUES(folder_id) ELSE wa_group.folder_id END, display_name = CASE WHEN VALUES(updated_at) >= wa_group.updated_at OR VALUES(created_at) < wa_group.created_at THEN COALESCE(VALUES(display_name), wa_group.display_name) ELSE wa_group.display_name END, avatar_url = CASE WHEN VALUES(updated_at) >= wa_group.updated_at OR VALUES(created_at) < wa_group.created_at THEN COALESCE(VALUES(avatar_url), wa_group.avatar_url) ELSE wa_group.avatar_url END, remark = CASE WHEN VALUES(updated_at) >= wa_group.updated_at OR VALUES(created_at) < wa_group.created_at THEN VALUES(remark) ELSE wa_group.remark END, deleted_at = CASE WHEN VALUES(updated_at) >= wa_group.updated_at OR VALUES(created_at) < wa_group.created_at THEN VALUES(deleted_at) ELSE wa_group.deleted_at END, origin = CASE WHEN VALUES(created_at) < wa_group.created_at THEN VALUES(origin) ELSE wa_group.origin END, created_at = LEAST(wa_group.created_at, VALUES(created_at)), updated_at = GREATEST(wa_group.updated_at, VALUES(updated_at))
